competitive_landscape: OceanJet and other fast-ferry operators run the established inter-island network — demand proof and potential partners, not threats.
demand_signals: Mactan-Cebu International Airport drives heavy airport→resort and airport→island transfer demand.
Established fast-ferry network (OceanJet and peers) across Cebu–Bohol–Dumaguete–Siquijor = demand proof.
Dense resort cluster on Mactan and Panglao (Bohol) with daily transfer flows.
Diving and island-hopping tourism (Moalboal, Oslob, Malapascua) generates premium day-trip demand.

navier_fit: Cebu is a textbook dense-archipelago hub: Pioneer II (70 nm) covers the high-frequency Cebu–Bohol–Mactan–Camotes core, while Quanta-LR (700 nm hybrid) handles longer Negros/Leyte/Manila-facing legs without charging infrastructure. The existing fast-ferry network is demand proof and a public-transport partnering path.
precedents: Indonesian and Maldivian island-hopping clusters in the atlas show resort + airport transfer as the entry pattern for hospitality-led marine mobility.
regulatory_note: Coordinate with MARINA (Maritime Industry Authority), Philippine Ports Authority, and Cebu/LGU port operators. Cabotage and domestic-flag rules apply.
seasonality: Year-round; habagat (SW monsoon, ~Jun–Oct) and typhoon season elevates cancellation risk on small craft — the reliability hook for a more capable platform. Amihan (NE, Dec–Feb) is peak.
sources: Philippine inter-island fast-ferry route/ridership data (OceanJet and peers)
summary: Cebu is the central Philippines' commercial and tourism hub, anchored by Cebu City and Mactan Island (home to the international airport and the Mactan resort strip). The surrounding Central Visayas is a tight archipelago — Bohol/Panglao, Camotes, Mactan, Dumaguete, Siquijor — where ferries and bangka boats are the connective tissue. Resort transfers, island-hopping day trips, and inter-island commuting are constant and currently served by conventional fast ferries (OceanJet, etc.) and small craft. Pioneer II covers the dense inner-Visayas hops; Quanta-LR opens longer inter-island and Manila-facing line-hauls.
tagline: The Visayas hub — a dense island cluster where every high-value trip already crosses water.
